 Widely scattered severe storms probable until around midnight; cooler and breezy for your Tuesday | 11/02 PM 
 Widely scattered severe storms probable until around midnight; cooler and breezy for your Tuesday | 11/02 PM By Michael Amankwaa and Barrett Phillips Published : Nov. 2, 2026 at 7:00 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LAWTON, Okla. (KSWO) -We will continue to see the threat of large hail, damaging winds, and a few isolated tornadoes this evening. The risk will be mainly in our eastern and southeastern counties until around midnight. Afterwards, the activity will be out of here as it pushes into Central and Eastern Oklahoma. A cold front moves in behind this system and we cool off for your Election Day. Highs will be in the upper 60s to low 70s with winds out of the northwest sustained between 10 to 20 mph. 
 Meteorologist Michael Amankwaa
